program_comparison.1_entry: Original-entry score, Cross replacement, activity-clock and reopening-jump bundles remain closed. No new entry feature/model/clock/threshold rescue of those opportunities.
program_comparison.2_external: External economic sources/events remain excluded; only original EA births, closes and US30/US100 native prices are used.
program_comparison.3_order_time: Passive price, market wait and original reservation studies stay closed; no fill-placement, wait-time or queue reallocation candidate.
program_comparison.4_management: Original-position early close and profit-stop ratchet stay closed. This proposal does not change any original stop, target, mandatory hold or original exit. A new inventory leg has its own initial protection and must complete when its parent completes.
program_comparison.5_capital: Select intra-lifecycle convex inventory expansion: at the first completed-minute favorable move of one original gross-stop distance, optionally open one same-direction child at the parent quantity, with independently reserved4%risk and a fixed midpoint stop. Parent risk remains fully reserved and original12%/45%caps include every child. This changes the number and path of positions after a winner appears, rather than initial sizing, daily component weights or spread-book replacement.
program_comparison.7_meta: The fixed unfiltered-child reference identifies whether learning improves the new action law. Full shadow-child outcomes mature even for declined branches; original parent and shared-account counterfactual limits are explicit, with no checker/safety project.

distinctness: No original signal, parent initial quantity, parent protective stop or original exit is modified. One new child inventory branch is introduced only after an actual winning-price excursion; no child-of-child or repeated scale-in. This is neither an initial-entry risk multiplier nor a component-weight/subset rescue, pair hedge or tighter-parent-stop retry. Child gross risk adds to full parent reservation, without unrealized-profit/net-risk credit.
